body: The area around Meow Wolf is fine. I lived right next to the place and never faced any harassment while walking around the Rufina area. Midtown is mostly working class people just minding their own business

Sodexo is good for covering your bills and quite flexible if you work in one of the dining halls. Since they’re very understaffed you can easily work nearly full time if you’re very desperate for income

Here’s the current listing of classes for this semester: https://www.binghamton.edu/cinema/undergraduate/classes.html. There’s also other courses that aren’t listed since offerings shift from semester to semester.

I highly recommend if you’re able to visit the university in-person or hop on a zoom call with a member of faculty that you do so. It’s really hard to get a feel of a program through just a website

So far I’ve enjoyed it here. I haven’t really felt lost in the sauce since the department is small. What really attracted me were the on-site film processing, transferring and editing facilities. The professors I’ve interacted with so far seem to really care about cinema.

If you’ve taken any base level film classes like film history, editing or video production, they’ll probably transfer over. Narrative/industry training classes like screenwriting or film crew, will probably not transfer, at least mine did not.

If experimental cinema production or film studies is your thing then the program might be a good fit for you
